You don't need to type faster.

FastBoard — a keyboard built to end repetitive typing.

You have a handful of phrases you type ten times a day. Email replies, team chat messages, e-commerce customer service, sales quotes... every time from scratch, every time word for word identical.

Now, save those phrases in FastBoard. Tap once, paste, done. Works in any app. No abbreviations to memorize, no commands to learn.

Sounds simple, but the details are where it gets good:

■ Phrase Titles — Keep Only What Matters on the Keyboard

Give frequent phrases a short name so they are easier to recognize on the keyboard. Forgot the content? Long-press for a full preview. Need finer edits? Open the Phrase Card to tidy it up.

■ Dynamic Phrases — Text That Updates Itself

Set it up once. The moment you paste, it converts automatically. No more editing dates and greetings by hand every morning.

Paste in the morning and it says "Good morning." Paste in the afternoon and it switches to "Good afternoon" on its own.
You can also preview the actual output while editing, without switching back to the keyboard to test.

20 built-in variables, inserted with one tap:

- {{greeting}} switches between morning, afternoon, and evening greetings based on time of day
- {{clipboard}} pulls in whatever you just copied — tracking numbers, order IDs
- {{coordinates}} adds your current latitude and longitude for quick location sharing
- {{cursor}} sets exactly where your cursor lands after pasting
- {{enter}} auto-sends after pasting
- Date, time, day of week, tomorrow, yesterday...

Built-in variables not enough? Create your own.

Define your {{myname}}, {{company}}, {{signature}} — set them once, use them everywhere. Supports random rotation and nested combinations. Sales, customer support, e-commerce sellers, social media managers — anyone can build their own input workflow with FastBoard.

■ Phrase Move — Bring Scattered Reusable Texts In All at Once

Notes, chat history, support systems, old devices... it does not matter where your reusable phrases are scattered.

- Bulk import: paste multiple lines at once, and FastBoard automatically splits them into separate phrases
- Clipboard quick save: save the content you just copied into a collection directly from the keyboard

■ Unlimited Collections — Organized, Found in a Second

One collection for support replies, one for quotes, one for daily use, one for personal. Categorize your phrases with no limits. Pair them with 16 Morandi color themes to find exactly the phrase you need at a glance.

■ iCloud Sync — Switch Devices Without Starting Over

Phrases you created on your iPhone are instantly available on your iPad. Edit on multiple devices at the same time without overwriting each other. Your personal phrase library follows your Apple ID.

■ Privacy First — Your Data Belongs to You

Installing a third-party keyboard raises privacy concerns. That's completely fair.

All phrases are stored only on your device and in your private iCloud — never uploaded to third-party servers. This is a one-person indie keyboard. No investors, no ads, no tracking.

results.description:
This text summarizing app helps you summarize and analyze the important key points of your content in seconds.
How to use our Summarizer?
To get the summary of your long text by using this summary generator application, follow the below easy steps:
	•	Set the percentage of text you want to summarize
	•	Type or paste your content into the input box
	•	Or, upload your file from the local storage of your smartphone
	•	Click the Summarize Now button
You can then copy and download the summarized text into the local storage with one click.
Why use this Text Summarizer App?
This paragraph summarizer app wraps up a long article into shortened one and retains the actual meaning of your content.
You can further use our text summarizer because it provides the below best features:
Multiple Files Uploading
Our app supports multiple file formats and allows you to upload files in TEXT, DOC, and PDF formats effortlessly.
Summarization Percent
This feature helps you to set the percentage of the length of the content you want to summarize.
You can select from 0 to 100 and can get the summarized text according to your requirement.
Quick Results
This text summarizer app uses advanced algorithms and quickly generates an accurate summary of the input content.
Output Formats
Our app summarizes the text by using NLP and allows users to generate the summary of their text in the below three formats:
	•	Result in Bullets
Whenever you want to analyze your content, use our text summarizer app to generate bullet points. 
This feature helps you to create presentations and assignments effortlessly.	
	•	Best Line Formation
You can use this feature to get an overview of the whole content in one line. 
It helps you to summarize and understand all the key points of your content in a single sentence.
	•	All in One Summary
This format provides you with a brief summary of your content with the best line, best sentence, and all key points
Free to use for all
Our text summarizing app has free usage and can be easily accessed on a smart device. 
You don’t have to complete any signup or registration process to use this application.
